description: One-time backfill (admin only): close the open MACHINE-CREATED deadlines — both derived (from term/notice) and the ones created by AI extraction on import (evidence starts with [Extraktion]) — of contracts that are already expired, terminated or archived. These are the older rows that predate the automatic close on status change, so a long-passed deadline no longer surfaces as open. Reads the whole inactive-contract inventory page by page; deadlines a user entered by hand are never touched; safe to run again. Returns inactive_contracts_checked, contracts_touched and deadlines_closed.
name: recalc_contract_deadlines
